description: Vicky Espinoza, Nicholas Santos and Joshua Viers publish irrigation-district, crop and disadvantaged-community data for California’s San Joaquin Valley. The May 2024 Zenodo deposit mirrors a Dryad data package and supplies Excel and CSV tables under CC0. Its README documents district traits, water-right priorities, surface-water allocations, groundwater dependence, community indicators and crop revenue. Crop categories and county crop values use 2016 information, while other administrative and social variables have their own source years. The tables can inform allocation constraints and distributional outcomes in regional water-demand or agent-based simulations. They do not constitute a continuous operational supply record. Missing entries use NA, and transferability beyond the sampled districts remains uncertain. No related catalogue or prior-review record explicitly covers this collection, including its Dryad DOI. The README was read; the numerical tables were not downloaded.
